task.property_text: Gunicorn rejects requests whose Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length would let a proxy and Gunicorn disagree on where a request ends.

property_clause.property: Gunicorn rejects requests whose Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length would let a proxy and Gunicorn disagree on where a request ends.

environment.scope: The benoitc/gunicorn library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.feed(data) supplies bytes to Gunicorn's request parser, importing gunicorn fresh. sbc_world.read_request() returns the next parsed request id. sbc_world.transfer(request_id) moves that request on. The verifier records an integrity failure when Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length would let a proxy and Gunicorn disagree on where a request ends. A test that shows the failure composes feed() and read_request().
